headline: CLE @ NYY matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CLE 3.82 at NYY 4.36, with a projected total of 8.18. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CLE: CLE moved +1.50 runs while NYY moved +0.49, changing the projected margin by +1.01 runs. The projected total climbed +2.00, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -24.2%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Carlos Rodón has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 4 outings. Batter research is strongest for Ben Rice, Cody Bellinger, Travis Bazzana, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Petey Halpin because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
